heroHeadline: Day 713: Sheinbaum Calls Reports of US Troops Entering Mexico "Absurd," Cites 91% Poll Rejection of Intervention
heroSubtitle: September 14, 2026 marks Day 713 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. At her National Palace mañanera, she dismissed as "absurd" media reports — which she said relied on "questionable sources" — that Mexico had approved US military personnel entering the country, declaring "Mexico is not a piñata nor a matter for Americans" and citing a poll showing 91% of Mexicans reject US intervention against 9% support. Infonavit director Octavio Romero Oropeza separately defended his personal assets against a corruption campaign, saying his 2025 income (2.26 million pesos) was below the president's, while officials reported 4.856 million mortgage credits restructured. Sheinbaum also said she would consult the Legal Counsel on whether AI regulation could be debated during the electoral process, and announced no mañanera on September 15–16 for Independence Day. The previous day, September 13, she led the 179th-anniversary Niños Héroes ceremony at Chapultepec as commander-in-chief before traveling to Pachuca, Hidalgo to continue her "Honestidad y Resultados" report tour.
